data.description:
## Context / Problem
On `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`, `.github/llm-providers/README.md` says provider overlays set only `[llm.model_classes]` and that the matrix test rejects any other key. The committed overlays and `tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py` instead require exactly two model-selection keys: `[llm] model` and `[llm.model_classes]`. The scalar model is load-bearing because operations that resolve `cfg.model` do not consult class slots.

## Approach
Correct the README's overlay schema and enforcement description. Retain the deep-merge, provider isolation, credential, local-use, and verified-model guidance without copying volatile implementation detail. Workflow comment remediation remains owned by `sphalerite-bereft-tortoise`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The README states that every overlay supplies both model-selection keys and explains why the scalar model is required.
- [ ] The described matrix enforcement matches `test_each_overlay_sets_only_the_model_selection_keys`.
- [ ] Existing deep-merge, provider isolation, local-use, credential, and verified-model guidance remains accurate.
- [ ] Focused provider-matrix and documentation checks pass.
data.title: Correct provider-overlay README schema and enforcement claims
